thread:
alex: Heads up, seeing a cluster of H100 hosts in asia-southeast-1b throwing PTX compile errors + NVLink link toggles after last night's driver push. Pods restarting and some NCCL collectives timing out.

maria: Which driver did we push? Any firmware changes included?

alex: Deployed nvidia-driver 535.54.03 at ~01:10 UTC. Package also included nvlink-fw 2.1.0 and new nvidia.ko. Sample container error: 
```
[2026-03-17T01:40:12Z] ERROR kernel_launch: PTX_COMPILE_ERROR: incompatible sm_90 kernel (sm_90)
[2026-03-17T01:40:12Z] Fallback JIT triggered; cache miss
[2026-03-17T01:40:13Z] NCCL ERROR: connection timeout on rank 2 -> peer reset
```

sam: NVLink flapping will drop packets -> NCCL timeouts. Did DKMS or module symbols fail on any hosts?

alex: DKMS reported success across most nodes but 8 hosts show symbol version mismatch for nvidia, uvm. dmesg: 
```
nvidia: failed to load ptx module for sm_90: ELF-ABI mismatch
nvlink: linkstate changed: up -> down -> up -> down
```

ira: paste nvidia-smi from a bad machine?

alex: 
```
$ nvidia-smi -q | head
Driver Version : 535.54.03
CUDA Version : 12.3
GPU 0: H100-SXM (UUID: GPU-XXXX)
Attached GPUs : 8
Firmware NVLINK: 2.1.0
```

maria: Observed behavior: elevated p99 latency, some 502s from model-serving, and OOMs when JITs pile up. Affects primarily asia-southeast-1b AZ.

ops-oncall: Symptom list: repeated JITs, NVLink toggles, NCCL collectives intermittently failing. Workload impact: retried jobs and higher GPU sys CPU time.

devops-bot: You can roll back using `/rollback-driver 535.54.03 --targets asia-southeast-1b` (owner approval required). Change control CCR-2026-78 created.

maria: Triage options: 1) targeted rollback to previous driver ABI 532.14.01 on affected hosts 2) enable precompiled kernels / persistent JIT cache to reduce runtime compiles 3) ask vendor if nvlink-fw change is the root cause and request micro-patch.

sam: Rollback risk: will drop newer kernel modules and could conflict with nodes that already pulled other updated packages. Patch risk: vendor timeline unknown.

ira: I'll do a canary rollback on 4 hosts and monitor. Marking those nodes with label `infra:drain-no-sched` to stop autoscaler from scheduling.

sam: Autoscaler labels set; moved the canary nodes to drain. Also disabled cluster-autobackfill for the pool.

maria: For model-serving canaries, set env NVJIT_CACHE=1 and GPU_KERNEL_PRELOAD=1 to force use of precompiled kernels where available.

alex: Applied env flags to canary pods. Observed fewer JIT spawns but one collective still failed once. NVLink state on canaries stabilized after rollback of driver to 532.14.01 on 4 hosts.

ops-oncall: Cost note: repeated JITs spiked GPU wall time by ~2.3x on impacted hosts — flag for cost ops.

devops-bot: Vendor ticket opened #RDW-2026-118 (P2) referencing H100 SM90 PTX semantics and nvlink-fw 2.1.0.

alex: Collecting DKMS logs, kernel module symbol diffs, and dmesg for the 8 hosts to upload to the ticket. Also capturing `modinfo nvidia` outputs.

ira: Canary rollback completed at 03:02 UTC on hosts h100-ase1b-12..15 (driver now 532.14.01). NVLink flaps ceased on those hosts; NCCL collectives passed during a 15m synthetic run.

sam: Rolling remaining 4 problematic hosts now in a phased manner. Keeping autoscaler off for nodes in rollback.

maria: Adding an alert rule: if NVLink linkstate toggles >3 times/min for a host, auto-drain that host and page infra oncall. Also adding a temporary dashboard tile for PTX_COMPILE_ERROR counts.

ops-oncall: Follow-ups: finish rollbacks (ira), upload logs and symbol diffs to vendor (alex), vendor to confirm if nvlink-fw or driver ABI mismatch caused PTX compile differences, postmortem in #postmortems after stabilization (maria).

ira: Starting final rollbacks on remaining hosts now. Will report when we hit 30m stable window.

alex: Uploaded artifacts to RDW-2026-118: DKMS logs, modinfo, dmesg diffs, fw versions. Vendor acked ticket and requested trace of module build IDs.

maria: ETA to full stabilization?

ops-oncall: ETA ~90min to finish rollbacks and burn-in. Current plan: phased rollback + monitoring; pause cluster-wide rollback until vendor patch confirmed.

devops-bot: Reminder: CCR-2026-78 requires approval from @eng-leads for the rollback operation.

alex: thanks team, keeping thread updated. will attach final postmortem link once write-up is ready. :thumbsup:
